name: Do you have a documented process for identifying and responding to new vulnerabilities in your code, systems or supply chain?
conditionsText:
The process should cover vulnerabilities discovered through sources such as:
- vulnerability scanning
- security testing
- automated dependency tools
- supplier/vendor notifications
- vulnerability or threat alerts
- penetration tests
- internal reporting
- external vulnerability reports.
requirementTitle: Do you have a documented process for identifying and responding to new vulnerabilities in your code, systems or supply chain?
requirementDescription: Do you have an ongoing way of finding out when new security weaknesses affect your service and a clear process for deciding what to do when one is discovered?
why: A service may be secure today but become vulnerable tomorrow because a new weakness is discovered in software or a dependency it uses.
tasks: Do you have a documented process for identifying and responding to new vulnerabilities in your code, systems or supply chain?

actions.title: Do you have a documented process for identifying and responding to new vulnerabilities in your code, systems or supply chain?
actions.description:
Document how the team will:
1. monitor for new vulnerabilities
2. determine whether the service is affected
3. record the vulnerability
4. assess its severity and impact
5. notify or escalate it to the appropriate people
6. assign remediation work
7. patch, fix or mitigate it
8. test that the action worked
9. update the vulnerability register.
